notes.title: [Major Update + DLC Release] Update log V1.2.17.0718.1
notes.notes: [p]Hello to our most adorable Big Winners (๑╹◡╹)ﾉ"![/p][p]After weeks of round-the-clock effort, Big Winner has been updated yet again! This is a Major Update, bringing you gamepad support, the new dateable character Orion Xu, new sofa furniture, and most importantly—you can now invite your NPC friends to visit your lavishly decorated HOUSE, making your quiet home lively and bustling! Detailed updates below:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]NEW ADDITIONS[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]​​ New Dateable Character: Orion Xu，Complete storylines including marriage storyline[/p][/*][*][p] Controller Support Added​​[/p][/*][*][p]Friends Room Tour​​: Invite NPCs with max Affection Level to visit your home[/p][/*][*][p]Special NPCs (Zane Zhao, Dominic Chai , Jasmine) require unique methods to unlock1[/p][/*][*][p]New Side Quest: \[Wishes]​​，Unlocks Karma Cards: \[Focus Sense], \[Honored Employee][/p][/*][*][p]9 New Sofas​​，Added to scratch-off prize pools at Jianjian Decor & IHome Furniture stores[/p][/*][*][p] Post-Game Spouse Re-Selection​​，Redo spouse choice at Oracle Temple after game completion[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]OPTIMIZATIONS & ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Improvements to English localization，some Npc's name have been changed in game.[/p][/*][*][p]Furniture selection UI now auto-hides during decoration mode[/p][/*][*][p]Right-click to unequip Karma Cards[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned spouse selection interface[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted rewards for citizen quest \[Childhood Friend] → Claim new rewards from Parrot Aite[/p][/*][*][p]Improved gift/dialogue logic for some side tasks.[/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Fixed crash when using Karma Card \[Consolation Prize][/p][/*][*][p]Resolved Final Showdown crash with Wisdom Level 0 + debuffs[/p][/*][*][p]Reset scrollbar position in some UI[/p][/*][*][p]Restored wedding firework effects[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/p][p]Meanwhile, our Lucky Pack DLC launches TODAY! 🎉[/p][p]The DLC includes:[/p][list][*][p]Original Soundtrack (OST) + Music Player + Bonus Item Pack[/p][/*][/list][p]We hope all fans who love Big Winner’s music and gameplay will show your support!![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3798040"][/dynamiclink]Bonus Items Include:[/p][p]• Vehicle: Rainbow E-Bike[/p][p]• Outfits: Tuxedo Set (Coat + Black Pants + Dress Shoes), Wedding Gown, Veil Hairstyle[/p][p]• Furniture: Exclusive Floor-to-Ceiling Window, Exclusive Lucky Doll[/p][p][/p][p]--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/p][p]If Big Winners encounter any issues – [/p][p]BUGs • Sudden crashes • Save file loss • Corrupted saves • Game not functioning properly • Suggestions/Feedback –[/p][p]Feel free to contact us anytime through the following channels：[url="https://ifasupport@cedong.com.cn"]ifasupport@cedong.com.cn[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update V1.1.15.0627.1
notes.notes: [h3]新增[/h3][p]1.新增了赵知颜、柴凌潇初遇剧情，早上、中午、黄昏第一次进入古城区彩彩乐门前区域时触发[/p][p]2.新增了柳乐琪初遇剧情，拿到推荐信后，在鲁氏集团厂房内触发[/p][p]3.新增了寒星初遇剧情，第一次进入动玩游戏厅触发[/p][p]4.新增了莫黛儿和阿茉剧情，升至T7后在营业时间进入MORE服装店触发[/p][p]5.新增了陆闻澜初遇剧情，第一次进入天天超市触发[/p][p]6.新增了俞越的初见剧情，深夜前进入麦德门门前区域时触发[/p][p]7.7PM理发师徐赛文新增4种发型[/p][p][/p][h3]调整[/h3][p]1.重新调整了7PM理发师托尼与徐赛文的理发票奖池[/p][p][/p][h3]修复[/h3][p]1.修复了因果卡【失忆光线】对散票没有完全恢复购买次数的问题[/p][p][/p][h3]更新预告[/h3][p]下次比较大的更新应该是手柄和steamdeck的适配，时间需要久一些，预计2周左右完成[/p][p]日常的修复更新还是会继续滴~[/p]
